Supported on OBS >= 30.2 and python >= 3.10.

   - Docs can be found [here](https://github.com/Penwy/adv-ff/blob/feb2aada4cac11634f579ea2aad2fc8445065335/docs/doc.md).
   - Replay buffer functionalities are now available on officially-released OBS starting with version 33.0.0 of it. **No more custom build needed!**


### 1.4.0 changes : 
- Added support for the [vkcapture source](https://github.com/nowrep/obs-vkcapture) on linux.
  - Requires version 1.5.6 or newer of the plugin.
- Fixed pyparsing import on newer flatpak obs.
- added info to upgrade to obs 33+ for replay buffer functionality.

Supported on OBS >= 30.2 and python >= 3.10.

   - Docs can be found [here](https://github.com/Penwy/adv-ff/blob/9020cfc011d4f895f0fdcb932972e7012cee92d0/docs/doc.md).
   - Replay buffer functionalities are not yet available on vanilla OBS, until PR [#8955](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/pull/8955) gets merged.
   - A custom build of OBS 32.0.4 with replay buffer functionalities can be found in the assets section below.

### 1.4.0 changes : 
We can haz Twitch.
- Added tokens to insert the value of [Advanced-Scene-Switcher](https://obsproject.com/forum/resources/advanced-scene-switcher.395/) variables.
  - In particular, this allows fetching and inserting data from the Twitch API, or from obs-websockets messages.
  - Documentation for them can be found [here](https://github.com/Penwy/adv-ff/blob/main/docs/doc.md#advanced-scene-switcher), and examples [here](https://github.com/Penwy/adv-ff/blob/main/docs/adv-ss_examples.md).
  - This requires the adv-ss plugin being installed and loaded.

Supported on OBS >= 30.2 and python >= 3.10.

   - Docs can be found [here](https://github.com/Penwy/adv-ff/blob/0d2bec928274b7f2e30d1b6b6c9113c71088d731/docs/doc.md).
   - Replay buffer functionalities are not yet available on vanilla OBS, until PR #8955 gets merged.
   - A custom build of OBS with replay buffer functionalities can be found in the assets section below.

### 1.3.0 changes :
- Improved pyparsing import to now install local if not found
- Moved to the `with_default` data setting json serialisation functions
- Cleaned up the config function wrapping for pre 30.0
- Added a check for OBS version on load, and handling of outdated version.

### **Now with Automatic File Splitting!!**
Supported on OBS >= 30.0 and python >= 3.10.

   - Docs can be found [here](https://github.com/Penwy/adv-ff/blob/9aea6c5681796fd3957bc29d98a50eb0a919d582/docs/doc.md).
   - Replay buffer functionalities are not yet available on vanilla OBS, until PR #8955 gets merged.
   - A custom build of OBS with replay buffer functionalities can be found in the assets section below.

### 1.2.0 changes :
- Automatic file splitting, whether by time, size or hotkey will now correctly update the formatting too.
  - This works by hijacking the default file splitting, as a result it might be slightly less precise in particular for the size one.
- Improved the handling of pyparsing import failures, with a descriptive message and a procedure to report such issues with relevant info.
- Possible fix of the pyparsing import on Macos.

Supported on OBS >= 30.0 and python >= 3.10.

   - Docs can be found [here](https://github.com/Penwy/adv-ff/blob/0d5c36fc7bab72f13f672685d49c1e69134f52fa/docs/doc.md).
   - Replay buffer functionalities are not yet available on vanilla OBS, until PR #8955 gets merged.
   - A custom build of OBS with replay buffer functionalities can be found in the assets section below.

### 1.1.2 changes :
- Changed filename cropping to be performed only post-generation, and to behave correctly with multi-bytes characters
- Added zero-width spaces sanitisation (this can be changed with the `remove_zws` customisation parameter)
- Fixed default data arrays (counter) causing crashes : Electric bogaloo, this time I think I found out what the actual fuck is happening with them.
- Fixed ctypes wrapping on macos
- Added version number printing at script load
- From now on, to limit build actions, executables of the custom build needed for replay buffer capacities will be distributed in releases.

### 1.1.1 changes :

- Added sanitization to Windows filenames : the characters `* " < > : | ?` will be remplaced by an underscore.
- Fixed a potential crash on reloading script after adding it.

### 1.1.0 changes :

- Added counters, which increase every time a file is saved.
- Added tokens for the spelled out month and day name, `$Month$` and `$Day$`, as well as for abbreviated month and day, `$month$` and `$day$`.
- Fixed a minor error when `from_file` wasn't defined for newly created text sources

- Added `v$username$` as token, standing for the user's username.

- Limited the generated filename to 250 characters, so as to not overwrite the extension.
